text:
Armstrong plays down talk of Rangers transfer - gossip
- Published
Dinamo Bucharest winger Danny Armstrong says he has not talked with Rangers manager Derek McInnes about a move to Ibrox, while the chances of Jack Grealish joining Celtic are played down.
Danny Armstrong says he has not talked to Derek McInnes about a move to Rangers from Dinamo Bucharest despite the 29-year-old winger still being in close touch with his former Kilmarnock manager amid transfer speculation. (Scottish Sun, external)
England cap Jack Grealish is not on Celtic's radar as multiple clubs monitor the 31-year-old midfielder, who is out of contract with Manchester City in the summer and currently on loan to Everton. (Football Insider, external)
Tottenham Hotspur winger Mikey Moore is expected to see out the rest of this season at Cologne as there is no clause in the 19-year-old's loan deal that would allow Spurs to recall the former Rangers loanee early. (TalkSport, external)
Chelsea have joined the clubs interested in signing Scott McTominay next year, with 29-year-old Scotland midfielder under contract with Napoli until 2028. (TeamTalk, external)
St Johnstone captain Jason Holt has no immediate plans to retire from playing despite the 33-year-old midfielder currently working through his coaching badges. (The Courier, external)
- Sunday's English & European transfer rumours 
  - Published19 hours ago
- Naderi's 'lucky punch' keeps Rangers in touch 
  - Published15 hours ago
- Saturday's Scottish Gossip 
  - Published1 day ago
Celtic manager Martin O'Neill says winger Haissem Hassan will be back in the first-team picture picture for Thursday's Europa League trip to face Torreense, while striker Kasper Hogh was deliberately left unused in the win over St Mirren to keep his fresh for the Portugal trip. (The National, external)
Celtic are hoping right-back Alistair Johnston is close to a make a long-awaited return to action despite getting a scan and some treatment this weekend in Dublin. (Scottish Sun, external)
Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain says he is ready to step into the boots of Mika Baur, who has been ruled out for 10 weeks, after the 33-year-old former England midfielder's man-of-the-match display for Celtic against St Mirren. (Sunday Mail, external)
Motherwell chief executive Brian Caldwell believes the talent drain of our best young players down south has reached a critical point and has urged clubs to back his bid to introduce a scholarship scheme to stop it bleeding our game dry. (Sunday Mail, external)
A number of leading Premiership clubs fear having to make swingeing cuts to their youth academies due to an imminent loss of £125,000 each in guaranteed funding from the Scottish Football Association. (Sunday Mail, external)
digest_he:
קיצוני דינמו בוקרשט, דני ארמסטרונג, הבהיר כי לא התקיים בינו לבין מנג'ר ריינג'רס דרק מקאינס משא ומתן לגבי מעבר אפשרי למועדון, למרות הקשר ההדוק ביניהם מהתקופה המשותפת בקילמרנוק. במקביל, דווח כי סיכוייו של קשר אנגליה ג'ק גריליש לעבור לסלטיק נמוכים, כאשר קבוצות אחרות ממשיכות לעקוב אחר מצבו לקראת סיום חוזהו במנצ'סטר סיטי.

בגזרות נוספות, צ'לסי הצטרפה לקבוצות המעוניינות בשירותיו של קשר נאפולי סקוט מקטומיני, וגורמים בכדורגל הסקוטי מביעים דאגה עמוקה מהאובדן הצפוי של מימון לפיתוח מחלקות הנוער. ראשי המועדונים קוראים לאימוץ תוכניות מלגות חדשות כדי לבלום את בריחת המוחות הצעירים למועדונים באנגליה.
